metadata.scenario: A business owner calls to receive a quote for a bulk purchase order, including potential discounts. Category: Quote Request. Outcome: quote_provided.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I help you today? Hi, Margaret! This is Frank Miller. I’m calling to request a quote for a bulk purchase of services for my family. Hi, Frank! It's great to hear from you. What services are you interested in? We're looking at a combination of diabetic management and wound care, plus maybe some companion care. Sure! How many visits per week are you considering for each service? Thinking about three visits for diabetic management and two for wound care. Companion care would be once a week. Alright, let me calculate that for you. For diabetic management, it’s $70 to $85 per visit. Okay, that sounds reasonable. And the wound care? Wound care is priced between $75 and $95 per visit. Got it. And how much is the companion care? Companion care runs $25 to $30 per hour. Can you provide a total estimate for the week? Sure! For diabetic management at three visits, it'll range from $210 to $255. Wound care at two visits comes to $150 to $190. And companion care would be about $25 to $30. So, what’s the total? Altogether, it comes to roughly $385 to $475 per week. That’s a bit steep. Are there any discounts for bulk orders? Yes, we can offer a 10% discount for a commitment of four weeks or more. That would help a lot. Can you break down how that looks with the discount? Certainly! With the discount, you’d be looking at $346.50 to $427.50 per week. That’s much more manageable. Can we also set up regular transportation to the endocrinologist? Yes! Transportation services are available at $45 to $65 per trip. Perfect! I think we want that too, once a month. I can add that to your care plan. Will you need the same nurse for those visits as well? Yes, please! I prefer consistency with my care. Understood. I’ll make a note to assign the same nurse for your visits. Great! What do I need to do to move forward with this? I’ll draft a care plan and send it over for your review. Can I confirm your email address? Yes, it's frankmiller@email.com. Perfect! I’ll get that sent out today. Anything else I can help you with? No, that’s all for now. Thank you so much, Margaret! You’re welcome, Frank! Thank you for choosing CareFirst. Have a great day! You too, bye! Bye!
